comment: Plugins the owner directed to keep enabled although every skill they list showed no use in the last 7 days. tools/skill-usage/skill_usage.py reports such a plugin under plugins_excepted instead of plugins_unused_7d (the command center's synced-plugin guard). One entry per plugin: {"plugin": the /skill-doctor source cell (the plugin's manifest name), "direction": a dated paraphrase of the owner's direction, never a quote, "recorded": YYYY-MM-DD}. Empty when created on 2026-10-15.
